name: hash-line-comment
why: `#` is a comment in jsonic/the shared @tabnas/abnf lexer. The .proto language spec has only // and /* */ comments.

name: backtick-string
why: backtick strings are a jsonic lexer feature; .proto has no backtick string literal.

name: digit-separator-in-field-number
why: `1_0` is a jsonic-style digit separator. .proto intLit has no separators.

name: exponent-field-number
why: `1e2` is a float literal. .proto fieldNumber = intLit, so a float is not a field number.

name: underscore-suffixed-number-in-enum
why: same digit-separator leniency, in enum value position.

name: empty-file
why: an empty .proto is a legal (if useless) file; it must not crash the parser.

name: single-quoted-string
why: control probe: .proto strLit allows BOTH quote characters, so this must be ACCEPTED. It is here so the probe set cannot be read as 'everything unusual is rejected'.

name: hex-field-number
input:
syntax = "proto2";
message M { optional int32 a = 0x10; }
why: control probe: .proto intLit includes hexLit, so this must be ACCEPTED (as 16).

name: octal-field-number
input:
syntax = "proto2";
message M { optional int32 a = 010; }
why: control probe: .proto intLit includes octLit, so this must be ACCEPTED (as 8, not 10).

name: trailing-close-brace
why: trailing garbage after a complete file must be rejected, not silently ignored.

name: unterminated-message
why: truncated input at EOF must be rejected (the csv/json5 unterminated-at-EOF failure class).

name: json-object
why: the json5 leniency-leak probe: a jsonic document must NOT be accepted as .proto.

name: unterminated-json-object
why: the exact json5 leak input: '{a:1' errors with the json5 plugin alone but is ACCEPTED through the documented jsonic stack.
